description: Move nodes to another parent and/or child position in a scene, each subtree kept whole (owners, groups, connections). Always-array moves, applied in order. Saves once at the end. Returns: results[] per move with success, newNodePath and index read back, or error; warnings leads when a NodePath value no longer leads where it did. Refused per entry: the root, a node inside an instance or inherited, a target inside the node, a name taken at the target. Errors while a runtime session is live.

moves.description: Moves to apply in order. Each names a node and gives newParentPath, index or both.

index.description: Position among the parent children after the move, 0 = first, -1 = last. Omit to append when the parent changes, or to leave the order when it does not.

newParentPath.description: Node path of the new parent ("root" for the scene root; an empty string is an error). Omit to keep the current parent and only reorder. The node keeps its name; a child of that name already there is an error.

nodePath.description: Node path from scene root to move

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Scene file path relative to the project

name: move_nodes

index.description: Position among its parent children after the move. Only on success.

newNodePath.description: Where the node is after the move, in root/... form. Only on success.

resolvedNodePath.description: Where nodePath led before the move, in root/... form. Present when the node was found.
